translated: Next, we have one from Suirenka-san.
"I love Ena and Mizuki from N25, and Shizuku-sama from MMJ."
You just want to add that "-sama" to her name, don't you?
"When I heard you two would be appearing, I decided to write in for the first time."
"There are two things I'm looking forward to this autumn."
"First is the ProSeka Unit Fan Meeting: 25-ji, Nightcord de. in Oita."
"Back in high school, N25's songs supported me through the stress of entrance exams, and I passed."
"I started living on my own this spring."
"Now my wish has come true, and I can attend my first fan meeting."
"It feels like a dream to be able to meet the cast members I love so much."
"I want to enjoy it to the fullest as a reward to myself."
"Second is my first cultural festival at university."
"Until high school, I always had studying in the back of my mind, but..."
